references.text: Prohibition against sexual intercourse with animals in the Mosaic Law, where both men and women are warned against this act, which is called an 'abomination'.
Reiterates the prohibition against sexual intercourse with animals and establishes the death penalty for both the human and the animal.
A curse is pronounced over anyone who has sexual intercourse with any animal, as part of the curses on Mount Ebal.
This verse elaborates on the sentence by also requiring that the animal be put to death.
